# Generic files

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/generic.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **JFrog CLI 2.128.0**. Registered classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/${AW_REPO}/`

## Before connecting

- An existing repository; a local readme.md to publish.

Authentication: READ permission is required to resolve metadata and bytes; DEPLOY is additionally required to publish. Supply an unexpired Access token in AW_TOKEN; Basic authentication uses AW_USER matching the token subject. Token scope must retain the repository permissions; a token cannot grant access that its principal lacks.

Fresh client state: JFROG_CLI_HOME_DIR and JFROG_CLI_TEMP_DIR point to a newly created AW_WORK; download to an empty directory.

## Configure

Runtime-only configuration. Use a shell with tracing disabled; remove AW_WORK after use. No token is part of this recipe source.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export JFROG_CLI_HOME_DIR="$AW_WORK/jfrog"
export JFROG_CLI_TEMP_DIR="$AW_WORK/tmp"
export JFROG_CLI_REPORT_USAGE=false
jf config add aw --url "$AW_URL" --artifactory-url "$AW_URL/artifactory" --access-token "$AW_TOKEN" --interactive=false
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Publish to a local or one-node federated repository; remote repositories are read-only.

```sh
jf rt u readme.md "$AW_REPO/" --flat --server-id=aw
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**. Reads use the selected repository; remote reads require an administrator-configured upstream.

```sh
jf rt dl "$AW_REPO/readme.md" "$AW_WORK/download/" --flat --fail-no-op --server-id=aw
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, virtual, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Generic files have no package-manager metadata or dependency resolution. Virtual writes are deliberately omitted; configure and publish to a concrete deployment repository.
